ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white and grey pixels are concentrated in contiguous bands along the superior-distal edges of both lobes. The central, proximal, and inferior regions are composed of uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a significant vertical indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge, characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral tips of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, appearing as brown-white pixel masses.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological protrusions (barnacle clusters) are present at both lobe tips, creating an irregular and jagged silhouette that deviates from the smooth dermal line.
